Josh Gates chases the enduring mystery of Captain William Kidd on Expedition
Before facing the gallows in London, the infamous pirate claimed to have stashed a colossal hoard of riches along the Atlantic coast. To separate pirate myth from documented fact, Josh heads to Block Island, investigating coastal drop-offs and remote shorelines tied to Kidd's final days of freedom.
Can Josh find physical evidence of Kidd's buried loot?
Watch Expedition Unknown Season 3, Episode 10 on Discovery Channel India.
